function.name: month_lengths
function.description: Return the number of days in each month (Jan..Dec) for a given year.

messages.content: Use the provided reference tools. To add calendar days across a month boundary, consult month_lengths for the year and carry the overflow into the next month; reply with only the resulting date.
The start date is 2026-01-29. Add 5 calendar days. Reply with ONLY the resulting date as YYYY-MM-DD (four-digit year, zero-padded month and day), no words.

metadata.assistantTraceConstruction: Hand-constructed retrieval-then-reasoned-answer trajectory; month_lengths receipt is the fixture read-tool output; no compute tool and no fabricated error.
metadata.toolResults: month_lengths is an actual local read-tool execution on a holdout-DISJOINT date/offset; the answer is checked by independent UTC-epoch date arithmetic.
metadata.independentChecker: UTC-epoch recomputation: 2026-01-29 + 5 days = 2026-02-03 (Jan has 31 days; 29+5=34; 34-31=3 -> Feb 3); month_lengths(2026)[1]=28 (non-leap).
metadata.trainingEligibility: requires Organism compiler lineage/eligibility; development-only; disjoint from consumed v3 holdout cases/answers.
metadata.supervision: The month_lengths read is masked context; the checked final date is supervised. No context-free answer target.
